name: PURAV RAJA
bio:
Career Overview: Purav Raja is an Indian professional tennis player known for his expertise in doubles, competing on the ATP Tour and representing India in the Davis Cup.
Playing Style: A skilled doubles specialist with a strong net game, favoring indoor carpet surfaces, and renowned for his effective drop shot.
Career-High ATP Singles Ranking: #813 (July 30, 2007), Career-High ATP Doubles Ranking: #52 (July 17, 2017).
Best Grand Slam Singles Performance: Limited participation, mostly in qualifying rounds.
Grand Slam Achievements: Reached the third round in men’s doubles at Wimbledon (2017) and the US Open (2017).
Notable Achievements: ATP Titles: Won 2 ATP doubles titles: 2013 Claro Open Colombia and 2016 Los Cabos Open, both with Divij Sharan. Davis Cup & National Representation: Debuted in 2012 for India, partnering with players like Leander Paes, contributing to key ties. Challenger Success: Secured 15 ATP Challenger doubles titles, including notable wins in Kyoto (2013, 2014) and Pune (2016).
Other Highlights: Known for his successful partnership with Divij Sharan. Actively supports the Ananda Ashran orphanage and The Fellowship of the Physically Handicapped in Mumbai. Raja continues to compete, maintaining a strong presence in doubles tennis. 🎾🇮🇳
